name: New homes
tagline: Houses shaped by their land, light and shade
summary: A new house from first site walk to move-in: siting, design, permits, construction drawings and site visits, all with one architect who knows every decision.
deliverables:
Site and feasibility walk
Concept design with models and sketches
Design development and materials
Permit and construction documents
Builder selection help and site visits
body:
A new house from first site walk to move-in: siting, design, permits, construction drawings and site visits, all with one architect who knows every decision.

How it usually goes

We start with a walk and a conversation, not a contract. I will tell you what I would do, what it is likely to cost, and whether I am the right architect for it. If we go ahead, you get a written scope, a fee in stages, and a client portal where every drawing and decision lives.

I take four to six projects a year so each one gets my actual attention.
